description: This source file defines a public enum `WebViewJavaScriptSupport` with static methods to interact with a WKWebView, executing JavaScript to set debug status, evaluate JavaScript to string, and convert Swift strings to JavaScript values.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the WKWebView to set debug status and optionally update status messages.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates JavaScript in the WKWebView and returns the result as a String.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Converts a Swift String? into a JavaScript string literal, handling proper JSON encoding.
